record_kind: Compact projection of original offline analysis reports; no new solve or acceptance decision.

single-fin-static.boundary: Ideal clamp at the fin root/tab; one S6 shell midsurface instance.
single-fin-static.field_resolution: node displacement and element integration-point component maximum

source_report.attachment: Ideal clamp at and inside the body tangent; flexible root/bond not qualified

regional_stress_by_actual_thickness_mm.availability: Complete diagnostic retained in original report.

root_band_corner_edge_lengths_mm.availability: Complete diagnostic retained in original report.

thickness_profile.formula: t(x)=t_base+2*b*max(0,(g-x)/(g+i)) for x>=0; t=t_base for x<0; element thickness sampled at each element centroid and rounded to 0.01 mm section bins.
thickness_profile.model_status: Equivalent shell thickening for two side gussets; actual gusset bond/interface and three-dimensional foot detail are not modeled or qualified.

fields.component: displacement magnitude at S6 mesh nodes
fields.coverage_notes: Node displacement magnitude is a solver result on the explicit shell midsurface mesh.

assumptions: Ideal root clamp and tab restraint are model boundary conditions, not a qualified bond or joint.
Estimated material properties use an isotropic weak-direction surrogate for this screen.
Mesh refinement is a separate numerical convergence check and does not establish physical validation.
Numerical verification flags do not establish physical material, joint, or hardware validation.
limits: One fin instance only; no copying of the result to the other fins.
S6 shell midsurface values; shell normals and physical faces are not direct CAD vertices.
Stress xx is a component diagnostic only; no orthotropic failure criterion, margin, or safety pass is calculated.
evidence.uncertainty: Estimated material and idealized root boundary; mesh convergence status is recorded separately from physical validity.

registration.source_frame: FEM X=span from body tangent; Y=chord aft from fin front; Z=plate normal; mm
